headline: JPMorgan Downgrades Banco Bradesco and Cuts Target Price Nearly 30%
summary: JPMorgan downgraded Banco Bradesco and reduced its stock target price by almost 30%, following a similar cut by Itaú BBA. Analysts cited compressed margins and rising cap cost concerns.
why: Banco Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private commercial banking institutions.

impacts.name: Banco Bradesco
impacts.why: Analyst downgrades and lowered target prices trigger selling among institutional equity holders.

why_moved: Major wall street broker downgrades lowered target price projections and squeezed bank valuations.
